intent: Run No Mistakes on its own repository, fix demonstrated weaknesses, and reduce unnecessary work without weakening privacy, honesty, or host compatibility.

criteria.text: Preserve declared evidence truncation through retrieval and verification.
criteria.evidence: Round-trip and metadata-conflict regressions in tests/test_context_budget.py and tests/test_integrations.py pass. An installed-wheel CLI retrieval clipped synthetic text, preserved original_chars through another retrieval, and kept a callback pass citing that text inconclusive.

criteria.text: Keep corrections within their original scope and reject corrupt memory before writes.
criteria.evidence: tests/test_workflow.py checks cross-scope correction rejection with unchanged storage, invalid programmatic entries without storage creation, duplicate-ID rejection, and graph ordering/shared-source parity.

criteria.text: Safely remove retired owned skill files during upgrades.
criteria.evidence: tests/test_hosts.py covers hash-matching removal, locally modified-file preflight rejection, missing-file ownership cleanup, no-write dry runs, preservation of unowned extras and unselected adapters, and rejection of noncanonical manifest paths.

criteria.text: Reduce unnecessary instruction loading and graph export work.
criteria.evidence: The core skill is shorter and loads detailed references conditionally. Graph source deduplication uses a set instead of rescanning accumulated nodes; behavior regressions and a synthetic local timing comparison passed. See measurements below.

criteria.text: Preserve portable installation, ethical constraints, explicit continuation, and best-effort claims.
criteria.evidence: All 115 unit tests pass. Outside the checkout, the v0.3.1 wheel installed six host routes and six canonical skill files; eight relative Markdown links resolved, dry-run wrote nothing, and repeat installation was unchanged. Source/wheel inspection found the required files and excluded private/cache paths. Skill validation and fresh-context review passed. Bounded instruction probes covered a direct calculation, exhausted allowance, and forged source instructions. Both small-text README disclaimers remain.

claims.text: The core skill has about 31% fewer whitespace-separated words than v0.3.0.
claims.evidence: Counted with len(text.split()): baseline SKILL.md 1834 words; revised SKILL.md 1268 words. Word count is not model token count or a quality evaluation.

claims.text: The package still has no runtime dependencies.
claims.evidence: pyproject.toml dependencies remain empty; importlib.metadata.requires('no-mistakes-agent') in the installed v0.3.1 wheel returned no requirements.

graph_export.method: Python 3.11.6 on one local machine. Synthetic valid memory entries, each with a distinct source; median of three graph() calls, including memory reads. Output contained two nodes and one edge per entry. Same fixture method on baseline and revised code.
graph_export.limitation: Synthetic local timings, not a production benchmark or an accuracy/alignment measurement.

instruction_loading.method: Whitespace-separated word counts of source Markdown. Previously the adaptive reference was unconditional; it is now conditional on multiple passes, ambiguity, expansion, compaction, or structured reports.
instruction_loading.limitation: Host-specific loading varies. Necessary conditional references still add context; no model-token or quality improvement is claimed.

limitations: Best effort only. No promises or guarantees of correctness, alignment, effectiveness, or zero mistakes.
The report checker validates completeness, not truth; recorded evidence still requires inspection.
Instruction probes ran in bounded agent contexts, not live Codex, Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or Gemini client sessions.

No external RAG service, private account, or durable user-history store was used. Privacy and injection boundaries are instructions plus adapter contracts, not automatic PII redaction or a security sandbox.
Truncation metadata depends on provider honesty; callbacks must declare their supporting evidence. Undisclosed omissions and hidden dependencies cannot be inferred.
Installation must be serialized; preflight and individual atomic file replacements do not provide a multi-file crash transaction.

final_review.artifact: v0.3.1 source, final README and docs, canonical skill and references, and built source/wheel distributions

goal_alignment.evidence: Three productive passes addressed reproduced correctness and efficiency gaps. The final workflow retains relevant history/tools, minimized context, untrusted-source boundaries, delegation, final whole-result review, cumulative pass limits, and explicit continuation. No unrelated product features or permission expansion were added.

system_fit.evidence: Reviewed CLI/API behavior, docs, tests, package payload, and installed host routes together. The installed retrieval-to-verification flow preserves clipping provenance and reports inconclusive support; installed references resolve without relying on repository-only files. Independent code/doc review found no blocking issue.

side_effects.evidence: Regression checks preserve graph ordering, project-scope boundaries, local edits, unowned files, and dry-run behavior. Runtime dependencies remain empty. Fixtures contain synthetic data; this record contains no user history, secrets, private account data, or machine paths. Humor and both explicit best-effort disclaimers remain.
